theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (e : Euclid P), ‖e‖ = 1 → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[1] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict (R.carrier ∩ (fun t : ℝ => t • e) '' Ioi 0)), R.orient x = ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℝ (Euclid P) ℝ (fun _ : Fin 1 => e) ∨ R.orient x = -ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℝ (Euclid P) ℝ (fun _ : Fin 1 => e)) → ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ, LocallyIntegrableOn g (Ioi 0) ∧ (∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))), ∃ k : ℤ, g t = k) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, ∫ x in R.carrier ∩ (fun t : ℝ => t • e) '' Ioi 0, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) x) ∂μHE[1] = ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), g t * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) (t • e) (fun _ => e)
